GRADE 5 SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Location, Position and Size of Kenya in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify countries that neighbour Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Location, Position and Size of Kenya completely.
   C. Location, Position and Size of Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Location, Position and Size of Kenya.

2. About Location, Position and Size of Kenya around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. locate the position of Kenya in relation to her neighbours using a compass direction,
   B. Learners should ignore Location, Position and Size of Kenya completely.
   C. Location, Position and Size of Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Location, Position and Size of Kenya.

3. About Location, Position and Size of Kenya in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify countries that neighbour Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Location, Position and Size of Kenya completely.
   C. Location, Position and Size of Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Location, Position and Size of Kenya.

5. About Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify main physical features in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage completely.
   C. Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

6. About Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. show main physical features in Kenya on a map,

   C. Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

7. About Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify main physical features in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage completely.
   C. Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

9. About Weather and Climate in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify elements of weather in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Weather and Climate completely.
   C. Weather and Climate is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weather and Climate.

10. About Weather and Climate around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. show main climatic regions in Kenya on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Weather and Climate completely.
   C. Weather and Climate is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weather and Climate.

11. About Weather and Climate in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Weather and Climate completely.
   C. Weather and Climate is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weather and Climate.

13. About The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify main historic built environments in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui completely.
   C. The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

14. About The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui around your home, which statement is correct?

   D. There is no need to practise The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

   D. There is no need to practise The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

17. About Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify main language groups in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites completely.

   D. There is no need to practise Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.

   A. show the interdependence of language groups in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites completely.
   C. Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.

21. About Population distribution in Kenya in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Population distribution in Kenya completely.
   C. Population distribution in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population distribution in Kenya.

22. About Population distribution in Kenya around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. show areas of high and low population density in Kenya on a map,
   B. Learners should ignore Population distribution in Kenya completely.
   C. Population distribution in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population distribution in Kenya.

23. About Population distribution in Kenya in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the effects of population density in different regions in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Population distribution in Kenya completely.
   C. Population distribution in Kenya is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population distribution in Kenya.

25. About African Traditional Education in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify methods of instruction used in African traditional education,
   B. Learners should ignore African Traditional Education completely.
   C. African Traditional Education is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise African Traditional Education.

26. About African Traditional Education around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of African traditional education in promoting values,
   B. Learners should ignore African Traditional Education completely.
   C. African Traditional Education is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise African Traditional Education.

27. About African Traditional Education in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. apply African traditional education in promoting values,
   B. Learners should ignore African Traditional Education completely.
   C. African Traditional Education is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise African Traditional Education.

29. About School administration in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify administrative leaders in a school,
   B. Learners should ignore School administration completely.
   C. School administration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise School administration.

30. About School administration around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. state duties of administrative leaders in a school,
   B. Learners should ignore School administration completely.
   C. School administration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise School administration.

31. About School administration in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate administrative structure of a school,
   B. Learners should ignore School administration completely.
   C. School administration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise School administration.
